subject: Halogen Retail - urgent path anomalies causing high error rate / latency
messages:
From: Ethan Clarke <eclarke@halogenretail.com>
To: support@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Halogen SRE <oncall@halogenretail.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: URGENT: Intermittent 5xx + tail latency spikes impacting checkout APIs

Hi Redwood team —

We're seeing intermittent 5xx responses and 99th percentile latency spikes (up to ~5s) for your hosted inference endpoints from our production region (us-west-2) starting ~08:40 PT. This is affecting our checkout flow; error rate rose from 0.3% to ~7% during the window (08:40 - 09:00). Our oncall captured a sample pcap and metrics (attached).

We opened a support ticket (SUP-4219) but wanted to loop in our account lead given severity. Any immediate mitigation you can put in place (fallback routing, increased retries, circuit limiter changes) would help while you investigate root cause.

Attaching: pcap-sample-10-05.pcap, halogen-metrics-10-05.zip

Thanks,
Ethan Clarke
Director, Platform Reliability
Halogen Retail

--

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: URGENT: Intermittent 5xx + tail latency spikes impacting checkout APIs

Team — forwarding Halogen's report. Symptoms: sudden jump in 5xx (user-facing), high P99/latency, region us-west-2, started ~08:40 PT. Customer is seeing checkout failures; this is a revenue-impacting incident.

Immediate asks:
- Neha: run initial network trace / DNS logs for proxies in us-west-2 (prefix: prod-usw2-proxy-*) and correlate with our egress router logs.
- Vivek: check serving runtime logs for retries, KV cache misses, and any routing fallbacks. Any sign of model exec issues?
- Jonas: prepare mitigation options (fallback model routing, temporary route pinning, DNS cache override) and an exec-facing one-page for Rishi.

I'll brief Rishi after 10:00 unless you flag anything blocking.

Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

--

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: URGENT: Intermittent 5xx + tail latency spikes impacting checkout APIs

Stephanie — quick findings from probe:
- Observed repeated DNS NX/timeout retries from our edge proxies to Halogen's resolver during the window. Several probes show TTLs of 30s on their side but our proxy cache entries were expiring earlier due to a misapplied cache-control override (last config push 2026-09-30).
- Asymmetric routing: packet traces show responses taking a different NAT path back into our peering fabric ~12-18% of flows, causing late ACKs and connection resets.
- Firewall session table occasionally hits high watermark on a small subset of proxy hosts (prod-usw2-proxy-4/7) — counters show session churn and short TTLs for ephemeral flows (~30s), leading to SYN retries and 5xx from upstream.

Attached: short pcap excerpt and grep'd logs.

Immediate recommendation: temporarily increase local DNS cache TTL to 60s on affected proxies, and apply session table tuning on the two proxy hosts showing high watermark. This should reduce the immediate error rate while we dig deeper into peering asymmetry.

Neha Kapoor
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
attachments: pcap-sample-10-05.pcap

--

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Mitigation options & proposed exec summary for Halogen incident

Stephanie / team — drafting the one-pager for Rishi, attaching the mitigation action plan. High-level:
1) Short-term (0-2h):
   - Increase DNS cache TTL to 60s on prod-usw2-proxy-* (force config rollout); rollback in 24h if no regression.
   - Apply session table tuning (increase conntrack and extend ephemeral state to 120s) on proxy-4 and proxy-7.
   - Enable fallback routing: route requests to secondary peering path (regional mirror) for 25% of traffic to cut tail-latency spikes.
2) Mid-term (2-48h):
   - Work with Halogen's network team + CloudX (their transit provider) to identify asymmetry causes — BGP path/peering misconfig or NAT translation inconsistency.
   - Instrument additional TCP retransmit and path metrics on impacted hosts.
3) Post-mortem / RCA (72h):
   - Full packet capture review, BGP/RIB diff, and config-change timeline.

Attach: mitigation-action-plan-2026-10-06.pdf (one-pager + rollback instructions). Recommend an executive sync at 10:00 PT to authorize the short-term mitigations.

Jonas Weber
Head of Edge Reliability, Redwood Inference
Attachments: mitigation-action-plan-2026-10-06.pdf

--

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Clarke <eclarke@halogenretail.com>, Halogen SRE <oncall@halogenretail.com>, Sahil Gupta <sahil@cloudxops.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-07T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Halogen incident — interim resolution, RCA next steps, and exec recap (SUP-4219)

Ethan / Halogen team —

Thanks again for the rapid report and packet captures. Quick summary of where we are and next steps:

What happened (interim RCA):
- Root causes identified: (1) DNS cache TTL override on our side caused aggressive expiration and repeat lookups during normal churn; (2) asymmetric peering/NAT paths between Redwood and Halogen's transit provider produced ~12-18% of flows with delayed ACKs and connection resets; (3) two edge proxy hosts briefly hit session table high-water marks which amplified transient failures into 5xx returns.

What we did (actions performed Oct 6):
- Increased DNS cache TTL to 60s on affected prod proxies (rolled out 09:15 PT).
- Tuned conntrack/session table limits on prod-usw2-proxy-4 and -7.
- Routed 25% of traffic to an alternate regional mirror to reduce tail-path exposure.

Impact: error rate dropped from ~7% to <0.5% within 20 minutes of mitigation; P99 latency dropped from ~4.8s to ~320ms in the affected window. No user-facing regressions since Oct 6 09:40 PT.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Joint network deep-dive w/ Halogen + CloudX (owner: Jonas) — schedule 48h.
- Full packet capture and BGP/RIB diff analysis (owner: Neha) — deliverable 72h.
- Formal RCA doc and customer exec summary (owner: Stephanie) — draft in 72h, final in 7 days.

Attachments and links: mitigation-action-plan-2026-10-06.pdf; JIRA SUP-4219; link to runbook and captures: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xQ-runbook-example

If you'd like, we'll include execs on a brief 20-minute readout later this week. Please confirm preferred times.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
